characters.name: Emmeline Lestrange
characters.description: Little niece of Arthur Lestrange; child who grows up on the island, later the mother of Hannah; central female protagonist.

characters.name: Arthur Lestrange
characters.description: Passenger on the Northumberland, uncle and guardian of Emmeline and Dick; ill man who seeks to protect the children and later obsessively searches for them.

characters.name: Dick (Lestrange’s son)
characters.description: Arthur Lestrange’s little son; grows up on the island with Emmeline, becomes a skilled survivor and Emmeline’s partner.

characters.name: Paddy Button
characters.description: Old shell-back sailor who cares for the children after the shipwreck; practical fo'c's'le character (later dies aboard the brig).

characters.name: Captain Le Farge
characters.description: Master of the Northumberland (referred to as the ship’s "old man"); directs evacuation during the fire.

characters.name: Mrs Stannard
characters.description: Stewardess on the Northumberland who looks after the children aboard ship.

characters.name: Jenkins
characters.description: Steward mentioned aboard the Northumberland (criticized by the captain).

characters.name: Ohio
characters.description: A crew/passenger voice identified by origin and addressed by that sobriquet in the fo'c's'le dialogue.

characters.name: Buck M'Cann
characters.description: Character in Paddy Button’s anecdote; an eccentric village man in Button’s Connaught reminiscences.

characters.name: Tim
characters.description: Referred to as Paddy Button’s elder brother in a recollected tale told by Button.

characters.name: Larry Marr
characters.description: Man mentioned in Button’s backstory who shanghaied Button in 'Frisco; part of Button’s past.

characters.name: Jack Rafferty
characters.description: Sailor mentioned in Button’s reminiscences (example of a fo’c’s’le casualty).

characters.name: Mrs James
characters.description: Acquaintance in Boston who gave Emmeline the small cardboard box/tea-set; referenced in Emmeline’s memories.

characters.name: Mrs Sims
characters.description: Doctor’s wife mentioned in the children’s recollections in Boston.

characters.name: Jane
characters.description: Servant referenced in Boston anecdotes (appears in children’s memories).

characters.name: Koko
characters.description: Tame blue bird kept by Emmeline; a recurring named animal companion on the island.

characters.name: Hannah
characters.description: The child born to Emmeline and Dick on the island (male child given the name Hannah in the narrative).

characters.name: Merrows
characters.description: Mythical sea-people invoked in sailors’ tales and local lore within the narrative.

characters.name: Leprachaun
characters.description: Mythical Irish creature mentioned in fo'c's'le tales (part of Button’s folklore references).

characters.name: Troll
characters.description: Mythical creature referenced in sailors’ dialogue (term used in conversation).

characters.name: Cluricaunes
characters.description: Irish fairy-like beings (tinker of the Good People) mentioned in Button’s stories and in island lore within the narrative.

characters.name: Captain Simon J. Fountain
characters.description: Former whaler (Simon J. Fountain) who provides Lestrange with the crucial lead (the boxed tea-set) about the island where the children’s box was found.

characters.name: Captain Stannistreet
characters.description: Master of the schooner Raratonga engaged to pursue the search for Lestrange’s children.

characters.name: Wannamaker
characters.description: Agent/advertising contact in San Francisco who places Lestrange’s notices and helps arrange interviews; appears as Lestrange’s business contact.
